title: Developing Shared Network Vision in a Rural STEM Research‐Practice Partnership
authors: Emilie Hancock, Allyson Rogan‐Klyve, Brent Hancock et al.
why: Asks how a research-practice partnership builds and keeps a shared vision in its early years. That is the practical question behind your living-lab work.
caveat: One rural network in the United States. The findings are bound to that context.
